cluster.kubectl_note: the Kubernetes client built into oc, invoked as kubectl

entries.cmd: oc apply -f too-big.yaml && sleep 10 && oc get pod too-big && oc get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=too-big -o custom-columns=REASON:.reason,MESSAGE:.message
entries.stdout:

NAME      READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
too-big   0/1     Pending   0          10s
REASON             MESSAGE

entries.cmd: oc apply -f limited.yaml && oc wait --for=condition=Ready pod/limited --timeout=180s >/dev/null && oc exec limited -- cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max

oc apply -f hungry.yaml && sleep 30 && oc get pod hungry && oc get pod hungry -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.reason} exit={.status.containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.exitCode}{"\n"}'

verify.cmd:
names=$(oc get limitranges,resourcequotas -n academy-lesson-b-resources-qos -o name) || exit 1
test -z "$names"

snapshot.cmd: oc get limitranges,resourcequotas -A -o json | jq -S '[.items[] | {kind,namespace:.metadata.namespace,name:.metadata.name,spec}] | sort_by(.kind,.namespace,.name)'
